entry.title: Merge tag 'assoc-array-fixes-v2'
entry.content:
Clean up assoc_array library code
I had already gotten rid of this tag locally, because we then decided to just remove the assoc_array library entirely since it has only one single user - the key handling code - and that user is getting rewritten to use rhashtable instead.
But that removal is scheduled for 7.5, and this fixes real bugs and does clean up some of the code. So while it's all slated for removal, some of the fixes need back-porting and we might as well remove the cleaned-up version. Maybe somebody decides they want to resurrect it for another project - it really is fairly generic library code - they shouldn't get the messy end state that we decided to jettison.
Background: Nils Ollrogge reported a bug in the assoc_array library and had a patch to fix it too, but that code was too obscure for me to follow, so I used some LLM tools to help make sense of it all and found more issues in the process.
* tag 'assoc-array-fixes-v2': assoc_array: use assoc_array_parent_link() when splitting a shortcut assoc_array: find and collapse in deletion without gotos assoc_array: move deletion's collapse into a function of its own assoc_array: replace the labels in gc's tree walk with a loop assoc_array: move gc's folding into a function of its own assoc_array: keep gc's cleanup out of the live tree on allocation failure assoc_array: don't chain a new shortcut onto an existing one assoc_array: choose between splitting a node and a shortcut without gotos assoc_array: move shortcut creation into a function of its own assoc_array: move node splitting into a function of its own assoc_array: fill the segment cache in one place assoc_array: move in-place insertion into a function of its own assoc_array: don't lose objects when a root shortcut is split at level 4 assoc_array: don't lose objects when a shortcut is split on a word boundary assoc_array: correct the documentation of get_key_chunk()'s level argument

entry.title: Merge tag 'char-misc-7.4-rc4' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/gregkh/char-misc
entry.content:
Pull char/misc/iio driver fixes from Greg KH: "Here are a bunch of char, misc, and iio driver fixes for reported problems for 7.4-rc4. Included in here are:
- usual collection of lots of IIO driver fixes for issues
- binder driver fix
- iio, w1, and comedi driver fixes found and fixed by Josef
- comedi driver fix for a reported problem
- other misc driver fixes
All of these have been in linux-next for a while with no reported issues"
* tag 'char-misc-7.4-rc4' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/gregkh/char-misc: (68 commits) iio: hid-sensors: fix fractional part for unit exponents -7 and -8 iio: trigger: free the trigger ID after device_del() iio: hid-sensors: fix a division by zero iio: humidity: hid-sensor-humidity: Use per-instance callbacks iio: temperature: hid-sensor-temperature: Use per-instance callbacks comedi: comedi_bond: Fix leak of opened device references mei: me: add ice lake point LP iTouch DID mei: lb: read the MTU once rust_binder: push BR_TRANSACTION_COMPLETE before BR_FAILED_REPLY misc: ibmvmc: initialize HMC state before device registration w1: w1_therm: leave the slaves of other families alone w1: w1_therm: lock the list of slaves for the bulk read w1: don't hold list_mutex while a slave is torn down w1: netlink: drop the slave after the bus is unlocked w1: ds2805: use the bus mutex to talk on the bus w1: ds28e04: use the bus mutex to talk on the bus w1: ds2482: set the strong pull-up with its byte w1: remove the master's files before taking its locks w1: use the bus mutex for the "rw" file misc: bcm-vk: fix DMA allocation memory leak ...

entry.title: Merge tag 'tty-7.4-rc4' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/gregkh/tty
entry.content:
Pull tty/serial driver fixes from Greg KH: "Here are some small tty and serial driver fixes for reported problems for 7.4-rc4. Included in here are:
- tty driver and vt fixes reported and fixed by Josef Bacik and Chris Mason
- some serial driver fixes by Jiri for found problems
All of these have been in linux-next for almost 2 weeks now, with no reported issues"
* tag 'tty-7.4-rc4' of git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/gregkh/tty: serial: samsung: put the previous baud clock serial: samsung: don't leak the tty on an RX IRQ serial: rda: free the interrupt on shutdown serial: imx: fix the tty reference of the wakeup event serial: fsl_lpuart: fix tty ref of wakeup event serial: 8250_mxpcie: handle hangup during break serial: 8250_lpss: don't divide by 0 above 6.25 Mbaud serial: core: respect runtime PM when sending x_char vt: serialise the producers of the flip buffer tty: fix misapplied compat_ptr() in tty_compat_ioctl() serial: 8250_hp300: reorder HPDCA code serial: 8250_exar: check priv->gpio properly
